spec.purpose: Isolated complete GDN comparison of original scalar, original K16 intervals and C64 envelope variants. The C64 route sums four zero-C native BF16 signed and absolute products, then applies the unchanged coarse bound with its conditional2^-19 allowance and every original K16 loss. Only supported operand exponents80..174 or signed zero may admit. Outward endpoints must produce identical BF16 WU, both state residuals, or the final ordered output consumer. Original exact replay covers ambiguity and exceptions; the unrounded FP32 state update remains canonical. Preserve U=V ownership, checkpoints, residuals and raw output/state bits. Six lengths and four modes cover zero, finite, subnormal and eligibility endpoints. Full8192 uses one warmup and three rotated attempts across all four variants and both alias modes, with same-stream phase events resolved after completion. All outputs and buffers compare with the original algorithm and independent CPU columns. The fourth variant is the compiled product kernel without diagnostic counters and receives null statistics. Product dispatch has a default-off C64 option, but this component process does not load the model; no new GB10 or retained-performance acceptance.

implementation: Four same-executable variants retain the original scalar route and original K16 interval route, and add C64 envelopes with and without audit counters. The fourth specialization passes null statistics and compiles out all audit writes, matching the new default-off provider dispatch. Host tests execute1200 actual wrapper submissions, selection cases and failures, including the original checkpoint path. Provider build provenance now names all interval headers. Four zero-C signed and absolute native BF16 products are summed in ascending FP32 order before each unchanged coarse advance. Its conditional native2^-19 coefficient and every original K16 alignment and normalization loss remain accounted for. Complete-dot eligibility requires each original operand to be zero or within exponents80..174. Unsupported operands invalidate the interval and use original exact replay. Outward endpoints must agree at the existing BF16 consumers: WU, both unscaled and scaled state residuals, and the output after its two ordered FP32 multiplications and final FMA. The unrounded FP32 state product and FMA remain entirely canonical. Per-variant unique CTA counters verify complete coverage and unused tails without contended global atomics.
correctness_scope: All raw outputs, final FP32 state, W/U, BF16 checkpoints and residuals match the original scalar algorithm, including U=V, immutable input buffers and guards. Independent CPU columns check the complete equations for zero, ordinary finite and exponent-boundary inputs; subnormal cases retain the original full GPU comparison. Native diagnostics cover192 reports spanning six lengths, four modes, four variants and two alias configurations, plus eight complete8192 reports with every warmup and measured attempt checked. The new host test connects coarse dot envelopes to all GDN consumers and checks73728 canonical prefixes under three conditional native perturbation modes, with41222 exceptional rejections. The pre-existing host consumer test additionally enumerates every representable point in narrow ranges crossing BF16 midpoints. Finite cases do not establish the native hardware error bound universally. Product selection changes only behind a new default-off option; this component process loads no model and supplies no new GB10 operator/token boundary.
timing_scope: One warmup and three completed measurements rotate all four variants and both alias cases. The full8192 clock includes shared input preparation, WU, complete state recurrence, output, interval evaluation, exact replay, per-CTA counters and same-stream event recording. Events resolve only after final completion. Uploads, allocations, resets and validation are excluded. Production uses1024-row segmentation. Phase medians are diagnostics and must not be summed into a joint median. Safety timing fields are zero placeholders with events disabled.

decision.decision: Proceed to same-DLL native provider and actual-model validation. The product specialization without audit counters preserves every checked output/state/intermediate bit, all guards and null statistics storage, and completes in60.169/64.4553ms versus82.3807/80.4678ms original controls for separate/aliased U. These generated8192 timings do not qualify the production1024 schedule or GB10 continuation. Keep the option default off and the existing tested runtime control until the real comparison passes.
